row.title: STALL-ACT-1: one reconcile slot per sweep let a single failing PR starve the rest for 6 hours
row.body: Sweeper runs 712-717: PR 1746 (code-conflict / ref 422) took the only reconcile slot every pass, so 7 PRs stalled up to 381 min while the 15-minute alarm only reported. Fix: each dirty PR gets its own try (4 per pass); an unreconcilable agent/ PR past the stall limit is closed as superseded and the executor refiles it.
